integrations.label: Queue depth
Batch size
integrations.hint: Events grouped into one delivery.

integrations.label: Retry attempts
integrations.hint: Delivery attempts per batch before the events are given up on.

integrations.hint: Delay before the second attempt; doubled for each one after.

integrations.hint: Upper bound on the growing retry delay.

integrations.label: Heartbeat (s)
integrations.hint: Interval of the integration.siem.heartbeat event, which lets a SOC alert on silence. 0 disables it.

integrations.label: Shutdown drain (s)
integrations.hint: How long a shutdown keeps shipping the backlog before giving up.

integrations.hint: UDP confirms nothing: prefer TCP or TLS for a SOC.
